summary: Tested new Reports features: Part-Time Hours Report (Month/Year + Custom Range modes) and Individual Personnel Report. Backend: 9/9 pytest tests pass for GET /api/reports/part-time-hours, /api/reports/personnel-list, /api/reports/personnel/{id} including missing-param 422, 404 for unknown id, and 401/403 for unauthenticated. Frontend: end-to-end Playwright flow validated — report type dropdown, PT month/year vs custom range toggle, month & year selects, date inputs, generate button, summary stats cards (Employees / Total Shifts / Total Hours), Employee Hours Breakdown table showing Test John Doe (1234) with 24h/24h YTD/1 shift, Monthly Breakdown, Recent Shifts. Personnel report loaded for Firefighter Test User (200001) showing Profile (payroll/rank/station/shift/battalion/phone/email/hire date/type), Leave Balances (Vacation 16h / Sick 108h / Holiday 26h with annual + used), all 5 tabs (Overview, Riding(2), Leave(0), OT(0), Deploy(0)) navigable. Print button visible, CSV export downloads correctly for both reports: 'part-time-hours-report-2025-01-01-to-2026-12-31.csv' and 'personnel-report-Test-User-2025-01-01.csv'.
critical_code_review_comments: reports_routes.py part-time-hours: 'hours' defaults to 24 when missing (record.get('hours', 24)); this can silently mask data-quality problems if a record legitimately has 0 hours or a different shift length. Consider requiring hours explicitly or logging when defaulted.

reports_routes.py individual personnel: leave_query uses start_date range filter — leave records whose start_date is before start_date but end_date within the period will be excluded. Consider $or on start_date/end_date overlap.

reports_routes.py individual personnel: certifications lookup uses roster_query by name ({'name': person.get('name')}); this is fragile — match by payroll_number or personnel_id instead of exact name string.
reports_routes.py individual personnel: deployment days = (end - start).days + 1 does not handle deployments extending beyond the report window; days can exceed the requested period.
ReportsPage.js is likely >1000 lines (line refs go into 1800s in review request) — consider splitting per-report subcomponents to reduce file size.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing seed (Test John Doe part-time; Firefighter Test User 200001).
